title: Testing nodejs: jest configs, serial tests, test DBs
answers: How do I run nodejs tests?
Which databases do nodejs tests use?
body:
- Tests use dedicated DBs (`test_posthog`, `test_persons`, `test_behavioral_cohorts`, `test_cyclotron*`, ClickHouse `posthog_test`), never dev DBs. Create with `pnpm --filter=@posthog/nodejs setup:test`; `tests/helpers/database-guard.ts` blocks destructive helpers on non-test DBs.
- Run one file: `pnpm jest <path>` from `nodejs/`, or `hogli test <path>` from repo root.
- Two configs: `jest.config.js` (`*.test.ts`, parallel) and `jest.serial.config.js` (`*.serial.test.ts`, --runInBand) for shared mutable infra, e.g. `src/ingestion/ingestion-consumer.serial.test.ts`, `tests/server.serial.test.ts`. package.json scripts `test:parallel`/`test:serial`.
- Unit tests sit beside source and assert with `isOkResult`/`PipelineResultType`.
